On-device text reading for "Scan a card" (tesseract.js 6 and tesseract.js-core, Apache 2.0; English
model from tessdata_fast, Apache 2.0). Loaded only when the person taps Scan a card, from this folder,
never from a third party. The photo and the letters read from it stay on the phone and are dropped as
soon as the card name has been matched. The reader is told to read letters only, never digits.
